card.fact_statement: The Bureau of Fire Protection was commanded to assist evacuation efforts during the 2025 Philippine monsoon floods.
card.source_span: He also commanded the Philippine National Police and the Bureau of Fire Protection to assist the evacuation efforts.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni shirika gani liliamriwa kusaidia juhudi za uokoaji wakati wa mafuriko ya monsuni ya Ufilipino ya 2025?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: Idara ya Ulinzi dhidi ya Moto
target_qa_variants.source_span: He also commanded the Philippine National Police and the Bureau of Fire Protection to assist the evacuation efforts.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Bureau of Fire Protection' to 'Idara ya Ulinzi dhidi ya Moto' (Department/Bureau of Fire Protection).

backtranslation_en.question: Which organization was ordered to assist rescue efforts during the 2025 Philippine monsoon floods?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the same fact and relation.
